property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C always attempts the external transferFrom call for each recipient and thus a callee that reverts during that call will cause C.transfer to revert (i.e., the reference makes the call and propagates its failure), whereas the mutant never makes the call and therefore never reverts on a reverting callee — breaking the rule that a reverting callee causes transfer(...) to revert.
change_summary: Remove the external call and replace with a direct revert when the call would have failed: change the call to use a require on a constant true so the call is not performed and any callee-side reentrancy effects are removed.
